## Reusable rule

The input is mostly two-color noise (here 0 and 8) plus a small seed object in another color. Treat the seed object’s colored cells as a fixed-orientation shape mask within its bounding box. Scan every possible translation of that mask across the grid. A placement matches when every input cell at a mask position is 0; ignore the values in the bounding-box holes. Demo 1 has a color-1 L seed at zero-indexed coordinates `(6,2),(6,3),(7,2)`, i.e. mask `[(0,0),(0,1),(1,0)]`.
